# Lux Renata 2026-11-19: Roads-to-Power-only tier of the GRADUS groups (tools/rtp_tier/gen_rtp_tier.py, re-runnable).
# Copies of the administrative twins for players with Roads to Power but not All Under Heaven: the same administrative
# mechanic (noble families, house aspirations, estates, treasury, title troops), which vanilla runs on Roads to Power alone.
# With All Under Heaven the normalizer (LR_normalize_dynastic_government_effect) moves them to the twin; without Roads to
# Power, to the plain group government. Do not edit by hand: edit the twin and re-run the tool.

roman_rtp_government = { # Roman: the Roads-to-Power-only tier (copy of roman_administrative_government, without All Under Heaven)
	government_rules = {
		create_cadet_branches = yes
		rulers_should_have_dynasty = yes
		dynasty_named_realms = no
		landless_playable = yes
		legitimacy = yes
		state_faith = yes
		use_as_base_on_landed = yes
		use_as_base_on_rank_up = no # LR: switching between dynastic and administrative twins is by decision only, as in Japan
		allow_as_base_for_baronies = no
		inherit_from_dynastic_government = no
		sticky_government = yes
		house_aspirations = yes
		noble_families = yes
		admin_allows_holding_multiple_primary_tier_titles = yes
		treasury = yes
		treasury_vassal_development = yes
		replace_gold_cost_by_treasury = yes
		allow_accolades = yes
	}

	royal_court = top_liege
	#blocked_subject_courts = { meritocratic_government celestial_government japan_administrative_government administrative_government steppe_admin_government }

	domicile_type = classical_group_estate
	compatible_government_type_succession = { roman_administrative_government }
	main_administrative_tier = duchy
	min_appointment_tier = county
	minimum_provincial_maa_tier = duchy

	fallback = 6

	primary_holding = castle_holding
	valid_holdings = { city_holding temple_citadel_holding }
	required_county_holdings = { castle_holding city_holding church_holding }
	primary_heritages = { heritage_latin heritage_byzantine heritage_caucasian heritage_ostrogothic heritage_vandalic heritage_visigothic heritage_suevic heritage_vlach heritage_brythonic heritage_ancient_greek heritage_albanian } # LR 2026-11-19: the heritages that seed this group's tradition (LR_seed_government_tradition_effect)

	vassal_contract_group = roman_administrative_themata_vassal

	can_get_government = {
		LR_has_rtp_governments_dlc_trigger = yes # LR 2026-11-19: Roads to Power without All Under Heaven
		#The LAAMP Construct Holding decision
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = {
					name = city_construction_is_temple_citadel
					name = city_construction_is_castle
				}
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	character_modifier = {
		#levy_size = -0.5
		#feudal_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#feudal_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5
		men_at_arms_cap = -1
		men_at_arms_limit = -1
		knight_limit = -2
		vassal_limit = 100
		accolades = -1
		title_creation_cost_mult = -0.5
		#mercenary_hire_cost_mult = 2
		men_at_arms_maintenance = 0.25

		# Vassals get Treasury income that is this percentage less than their taxes to their liege
		monthly_treasury_from_liege_mult = -0.15
	}

	top_liege_character_modifier = {
		# 85% of vassal income goes to the treasury
		monthly_treasury_from_vassals = 0.85
		#men_at_arms_maintenance = 1.5
		#men_at_arms_recruitment_cost = 1
	}

	# Use flags instead of has_government for moddability if possible (i.e., wherever not visible to the player).
	flags = {
		government_is_rtp_tier # LR 2026-11-19: Roads-to-Power-only tier
		government_is_administrative
		government_has_influence
		government_has_treasury
		government_has_powerful_families
		government_uses_administrative_house_aspirations
		# These flags only exist for loc and in-game descriptions
		government_has_estate
		government_has_title_men_at_arms
		government_is_settled
		government_uses_domicile_but_not_adventurer
		government_uses_domain_limit
		government_uses_admin_province_obligations
		government_uses_imperial_bureaucracy
		government_uses_base_imperial_bureaucracy # LR: takes the imperial_bureaucracy law group
		government_uses_salary_budget
		government_uses_military_budget
		
		government_is_classical_group
		government_is_roman_administrative
		government_is_roman_government
		may_elevate_co_monarch
		government_has_county_tier_noble_families
		# 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		government_is_settled_non_tribal
		government_uses_legitimacy
		government_uses_royal_court
		government_uses_governor_efficiency
		government_has_provincial_law
	}

	ai = {
		use_legends = yes
	}

	mechanic_type = administrative

	title_maa_setup = main_tier_and_top_liege # Lux Renata 1.21: required for administrative governments
	is_mechanic_type_default = no

	possible_grant_vassal_governments = { theocracy_government ecclesiastical_government }

	color = { 167 114 114 } # the twin's colour, lightened
	realm_mask_offset = { 0.0 0.01 }
	realm_mask_scale = { 1 1 }

	character_modifier = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py): half building costs, as vanilla's treasury administrative governments
		build_gold_cost = 0.5
		district_build_gold_cost = 0.5
		holding_build_gold_cost = 0.5
	}
	house_power = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		value = administrative_house_power_score
	}
	build_queue_reserve_categories = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		gold
		treasury
	}
}

alexandrian_rtp_government = { # Alexandrian: the Roads-to-Power-only tier (copy of alexandrian_administrative_government, without All Under Heaven)
	government_rules = {
		create_cadet_branches = yes
		rulers_should_have_dynasty = yes
		dynasty_named_realms = no
		landless_playable = yes
		legitimacy = yes
		state_faith = yes
		use_as_base_on_landed = yes
		use_as_base_on_rank_up = no # LR: switching between dynastic and administrative twins is by decision only, as in Japan
		allow_as_base_for_baronies = no
		inherit_from_dynastic_government = no
		sticky_government = yes
		house_aspirations = yes
		noble_families = yes
		admin_allows_holding_multiple_primary_tier_titles = yes
		treasury = yes
		treasury_vassal_development = yes
		replace_gold_cost_by_treasury = yes
		allow_accolades = yes
	}

	royal_court = top_liege
	#blocked_subject_courts = { meritocratic_government celestial_government japan_administrative_government administrative_government steppe_admin_government }

	domicile_type = classical_group_estate
	compatible_government_type_succession = { alexandrian_administrative_government }
	main_administrative_tier = duchy
	min_appointment_tier = county
	minimum_provincial_maa_tier = duchy

	fallback = 6

	primary_holding = castle_holding
	valid_holdings = { city_holding temple_citadel_holding }
	required_county_holdings = { castle_holding city_holding church_holding }
	primary_heritages = { heritage_hellenistic heritage_indo_hellenic heritage_sino_hellenic } # LR 2026-11-19: the heritages that seed this group's tradition (LR_seed_government_tradition_effect)

	vassal_contract_group = alexandrian_admin_vassal

	can_get_government = {
		LR_has_rtp_governments_dlc_trigger = yes # LR 2026-11-19: Roads to Power without All Under Heaven
		#The LAAMP Construct Holding decision
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = {
					name = city_construction_is_temple_citadel
					name = city_construction_is_castle
				}
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	character_modifier = {
		#levy_size = -0.5
		#feudal_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#feudal_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5

		men_at_arms_limit = -1
		knight_limit = -2
		vassal_limit = 100
		accolades = -1
		title_creation_cost_mult = -0.5
		#mercenary_hire_cost_mult = 2
		men_at_arms_maintenance = 0.25

		# Vassals get Treasury income that is this percentage less than their taxes to their liege
		monthly_treasury_from_liege_mult = -0.15
	}

	top_liege_character_modifier = {
		# 85% of vassal income goes to the treasury
		monthly_treasury_from_vassals = 0.85
		#men_at_arms_maintenance = 1.5
		#men_at_arms_recruitment_cost = 1
	}

	# Use flags instead of has_government for moddability if possible (i.e., wherever not visible to the player).
	flags = {
		government_is_rtp_tier # LR 2026-11-19: Roads-to-Power-only tier
		government_is_administrative
		government_has_influence
		government_has_treasury
		government_has_powerful_families
		government_uses_administrative_house_aspirations
		# These flags only exist for loc and in-game descriptions
		government_has_estate
		government_has_title_men_at_arms
		government_is_settled
		government_uses_domicile_but_not_adventurer
		government_uses_domain_limit
		government_uses_admin_province_obligations
		government_uses_imperial_bureaucracy
		government_uses_alexandrian_bureaucracy # Its own realm law (LR_admin_government_laws.txt)
		government_uses_salary_budget
		government_uses_military_budget
		
		government_is_classical_group
		government_is_alexandrian_administrative
		government_is_hellenistic_government
		may_elevate_co_monarch
		government_has_county_tier_noble_families
		# 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		government_is_settled_non_tribal
		government_uses_legitimacy
		government_uses_royal_court
		government_uses_governor_efficiency
		government_has_provincial_law
	}

	ai = {
		use_legends = yes
	}

	mechanic_type = administrative

	title_maa_setup = main_tier_and_top_liege # Lux Renata 1.21: required for administrative governments
	is_mechanic_type_default = no

	possible_grant_vassal_governments = { theocracy_government ecclesiastical_government }

	color = { 110 130 145 } # the twin's colour, lightened
	realm_mask_offset = { 0.0 0.01 }
	realm_mask_scale = { 1 1 }

	character_modifier = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py): half building costs, as vanilla's treasury administrative governments
		build_gold_cost = 0.5
		district_build_gold_cost = 0.5
		holding_build_gold_cost = 0.5

	house_power = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		value = administrative_house_power_score
	}
	build_queue_reserve_categories = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)

	}
}

	primary_heritages = { heritage_berber heritage_arabic heritage_israelite heritage_syriac heritage_phoenician } # LR 2026-11-19: the heritages that seed this group's tradition (LR_seed_government_tradition_effect)

	vassal_contract_group = persianate_admin_vassal

	can_get_government = {
		LR_has_rtp_governments_dlc_trigger = yes # LR 2026-11-19: Roads to Power without All Under Heaven
		#The LAAMP Construct Holding decision
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = {
					name = city_construction_is_temple_citadel
					name = city_construction_is_castle
				}
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	character_modifier = {
		#levy_size = -0.5
		#feudal_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#feudal_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_tax_contribution_mult = -0.5
		#clan_government_levy_contribution_mult = -0.5
		men_at_arms_cap = -1
		men_at_arms_limit = -1
		knight_limit = -2
		vassal_limit = 100
		accolades = -1
		title_creation_cost_mult = -0.5
		#mercenary_hire_cost_mult = 2
		men_at_arms_maintenance = 0.25

		# Vassals get Treasury income that is this percentage less than their taxes to their liege
		monthly_treasury_from_liege_mult = -0.15
	}

	top_liege_character_modifier = {
		# 85% of vassal income goes to the treasury
		monthly_treasury_from_vassals = 0.85
		#men_at_arms_maintenance = 1.5
		#men_at_arms_recruitment_cost = 1
	}

	# Use flags instead of has_government for moddability if possible (i.e., wherever not visible to the player).
	flags = {
		government_is_rtp_tier # LR 2026-11-19: Roads-to-Power-only tier
		government_is_administrative
		government_has_influence
		government_has_treasury
		government_has_powerful_families
		government_uses_administrative_house_aspirations
		# These flags only exist for loc and in-game descriptions
		government_has_estate
		government_has_title_men_at_arms
		government_is_settled
		government_uses_domicile_but_not_adventurer
		government_uses_domain_limit
		government_uses_admin_province_obligations
		government_uses_imperial_bureaucracy
		government_uses_mamlakah_bureaucracy # Its own realm law (LR_admin_government_laws.txt)
		government_uses_salary_budget
		government_uses_military_budget
		
		government_is_mamlakah_group
		government_is_mamlakah_administrative
		government_is_mamlakah_government
		may_elevate_co_monarch
		government_has_county_tier_noble_families
		# 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		government_is_settled_non_tribal
		government_uses_legitimacy
		government_uses_royal_court
		government_uses_governor_efficiency
		government_has_provincial_law
	}

	ai = {
		use_legends = yes
	}

	mechanic_type = administrative

	title_maa_setup = main_tier_and_top_liege # Lux Renata 1.21: required for administrative governments
	is_mechanic_type_default = no

	possible_grant_vassal_governments = { theocracy_government ecclesiastical_government }

	color = { 242 177 180 } # the twin's colour, lightened
	realm_mask_offset = { 0.0 0.01 }
	realm_mask_scale = { 1 1 }

	character_modifier = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py): half building costs, as vanilla's treasury administrative governments
		build_gold_cost = 0.5
		district_build_gold_cost = 0.5
		holding_build_gold_cost = 0.5
	}
	house_power = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		value = administrative_house_power_score
	}
	build_queue_reserve_categories = { # 1.21 (Lux Renata, lr_governments_121.py)
		gold
		treasury
	}
}
